The FloPlast 68mm white uPVC round downpipe socket provides a robust solution for connecting rainwater downpipes in drainage systems. Crafted from durable uPVC, this plumbing fitting ensures reliable performance for both new build and refurbishment applications. Its single socket design allows for quick, secure installation without the need for lubrication, streamlining work on site. With good flow capacity, it efficiently manages rainwater runoff, preventing potential blockages. This socket is also compatible with most major manufacturers' systems, making it a versatile choice for tradespeople seeking high-quality drainage solutions.
